scripts.db:reset: docker compose --profile app down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:test: docker compose exec -T db psql -U authz -d authz_demo -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/tests/invariants.sql
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:types && pnpm --filter @authz-demo/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @authz-demo/web typecheck
